text:
Farmers use fertilisers to replace elements in the soil that have been removed by the crops they
grow.
Which elements in the soil are replaced by adding fertilisers?
A
Ca, P, O
B
K, O, S
C
N, O, S
D
N, K, P
subject: Chemistry
